description: PowerGraph Sankey is an advanced custom visual for Power BI that enables you to create dynamic, interactive Sankey diagrams for visualizing complex flows and relationships in your data. Built on Microsoft’s open-source Sankey visual and enhanced by Stratada, PowerGraph Sankey introduces powerful features such as node sorting by value, enriched node labels with counts and percentages, and improved layout with final node labels displayed to the right for greater clarity. The visual fully supports Power BI’s filtering and cross-filtering capabilities, making it easy to explore and present key insights across a wide range of business scenarios.
